item.title: Arizona's taps won't run dry, but water bills will go up under federal plan for Colorado River
item.description: New federal rules mean Arizona will be getting a lot less water from the Colorado river. City leaders say they've been planning for years and no one will run out, but keeping taps flowing is expensive.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: A melting glacier contributed to the deadly Nepal floods. We can expect more like this
item.description: As the climate continues to warm, scientists warn that the frequency of disasters like the floods in Nepal will increase.

item.title: The role of climate change in the Nepal floods
item.description: The deadly flash floods in Nepal are not a surprise to many scientists. Glacial melt is accelerating because of climate change, putting millions of people at risk.
item.content:encoded: The deadly flash floods in Nepal are not a surprise to many scientists. Glacial melt is accelerating because of climate change, putting millions of people at risk.

item.title: Nearly 1,000 are missing in Nepal and Tibet after floods caused by a glacial collapse
item.description: China's Xinhua News Agency said Thursday that mudslides in Tibet caused by a glacial collapse have left three people dead and 558 missing, while police in Nepal reported at least 162 were killed.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Indonesians brave choking smoke to pray for rain as country battles wildfires
